countingNote: 127 Workbench groups plus payload HTTP, Mapper root suites and Node suites. BrowserBodyObservationTest is included in MapperTest and is not counted twice. The separate 17 actual Chromium DOM checks and layout scenarios are not added to 4786.
captureScope: Production Swing components with synthetic wire packets and browser observations. Actual Burp GUI and browser extension installation screenshots are not claimed.

browserDom.scope: Actual managed Chromium page DOM, production exploration and supplemental MAIN guard, loopback fixture and isolated profile. Does not prove MV3 or DNR transport integration.

browserExtension.reason: System-managed ExtensionInstallBlocklist prevents unpacked helper installation. Policy was not changed or bypassed.

toolchain.limitation: Local JDK lacks ct.sym; explicit source17/target17 used. Strict Java17 and Node22 checks are configured in GitHub Actions; see PR run results.

notRun: original lab all-features and bounty HTTP harnesses
Actual helper MV3/DNR integration (blocked by managed browser policy)
practicalLimits: The HTTP body setting limits decoded analysis, not the underlying Montoya download transport. Large dump/archive candidates are excluded.
Browser resource observations have their own page/action/time/count bounds and are separate from the strict HTTP inspection request budget.
Environment, DB and account differences are evidence for review; they do not certify a vulnerability, deployed technology or account identity.
Full raw packets remain in bounded current-session stores. Durable history contains masked metadata; export evidence explicitly when needed.
